title: Experimental-Bell command-level parity

source.basis: Stage 36 source audit and inventory; source archive must be revalidated before direct source transplantation

statusLegend.existing: Whiskay has a comparable feature; command-level equivalence still needs proof
statusLegend.partial: Some comparable functionality exists, but source commands/aliases/providers remain to be compared
statusLegend.gap: No dedicated equivalent was confirmed in the baseline audit
statusLegend.new: Whiskay-specific implementation exists but is not complete source parity
statusLegend.pending: Not yet audited command by command

families.target: dedicated RPG plugins and web integration
new TTS adapter after provider review

transplantRules: Keep Whiskay PluginManager and CommandHandler as the runtime authority.
Use Whiskay serializer adapters for all interactive messages.
Do not overwrite Whiskay RPG/economy transactions with source logic.
Every source command and alias must map to a target plugin or have an explicit exclusion reason.
Owner-only, destructive, privacy-sensitive, credential, and code-execution commands require separate security review.
Do not mark provider-dependent commands complete without configuration and failure-path tests.
README.md and docs/README.md must be updated in the same change as each implemented batch.
